summary: The fix renames the internal auth patch normalizer, preserves the public SDK wrapper, removes or makes private several unused exports, and links the existing oMLX guide.
reasoning: The reported failures were confined to the CI wrapper-shadowing guard and unused-export scans. I checked that #173327 added an SDK wrapper that delegated through an aliased import and that #174217 removed the transport redactor's call as part of an intentional logging change.
